info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-List Correspondent Bank Operation Status-spec
info.description: The Correspondent Bank Operation Status API provides access to the current status of various correspondent bank operations related to payment processing. It allows financial institutions and banks to efficiently monitor the state of transactions involving correspondent banks. Typical consumers include payment processing teams and compliance departments who rely on up-to-date operational insights to manage workflows and ensure timely communication with partners. This endpoint enables seamless tracking of operational statuses, which is essential for maintaining robust banking operations.

get.summary: Fetch the status of correspondent bank operations.
get.description: Retrieve the current status of correspondent bank operations to monitor their progress and outcome. This endpoint provides necessary information regarding the transactions carried out through correspondent banks.
